title: Driven Harmonic Oscillator
description: A linear restoring-force oscillator family with an externally prescribed drive and optional linear damping, including zero drive as a limiting case. Its motion combines homogeneous transients with a forced response; sinusoidal forcing reveals frequency-dependent amplitude and phase.

relations.note: Setting the prescribed drive to zero recovers the free damped oscillator family.
The sinusoidally forced linear model is a standard quantitative example of resonance.
